new_findings.text: REBUILD_READINESS.md:201 says the "271 cap" is gear/rebirth-inclusive and that a 237-point first-run budget makes 271 impossible in one stat, then files it as 'resolvable by arithmetic now'. It is not an arithmetic puzzle and it is not gear-inclusive: 271 is the literal hard-coded per-stat ceiling of the WEB build at the level cap. §1t5957s0§.as:3340 reads the character level into _loc2_ and :3344-3346 gate the ATK / DEF / SPD add buttons on 'stat < 1 + (_loc2_ + 10) * 3'. At level 80 that is 1 + 90*3 = 271 EXACTLY. The same block gives the other three ceilings for free: MAXHP < 10 + (level+10)*10 = 910 at L80, MAXCHI < 10 + (level+10)*5 = 460, MAXAP < 30 + (level+10)*5 = 480.
